GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (31 Oct 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 218)
APO 500
31 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Naval Radio-Telegraph Installations at Totsuka.
1. There is a requirement by Allied Forces for additional radio facilities in the Tokyo Area. The Japanese radio installation at Totsuka will meet the requirements of the projected Allied operations. Accordingly, the Japanese Government will make available the complete Totsuka installation for immediate use by the occupation forces under control of this Headquarters.
2. It is directed that the Board of Communications make arrangements to provide an adequate staff of transmitter attendants and maintenance technicians. Japanese Navy technical personnel who are trained in the operation and maintenance of the equipment may be employed in a civilian status.
3. Details of these arrangements will be coordinated with the Chief Civil Communications Section of this Headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
